name: Sam & Cat
description:
Sam Puckett is loud, independent, and tough as nails, while Cat Valentine is sweet as pie and super flighty. But that doesn't stop this unlikely pair from becoming best buds and roomies!

Together, they're a power duo with a love for fun and adventure -- it's just too bad that it doesn't come cheap. Burgers at their favorite robot restaurant Bots don't grow on trees, after all. A booming out-of-home babysitting business quickly becomes the answer to their empty-pocket problems, but also an extra reason for countless wacky adventures to come!

videos.title: #Pilot
videos.overview: Sassy Sam Puckett (Jennette McCurdy) and eccentric Cat Valentine (Ariana Grande) buddy up as roommates after Sam rescues Cat from a garbage truck.

videos.title: #FavoriteShow
videos.overview: Sam and Cat attempt to save their favorite TV show from being cancelled while babysitting two boys.

videos.title: #TheBritBrats
videos.overview: Sam and Cat babysit two polite, British girls. Sam tries to fulfill a community service requirement at Elderly Acres.

videos.title: #NewGoat
videos.overview: Sam and Cat babysit a pygmy goat while trying to win over their landlord's son. Dice begins to manage a mixed martial arts fighter.

videos.title: #TextingCompetition
videos.overview: Cat persuades Sam to enter a texting competition where she faces off against a sweet boy with domineering mother. Dice attempts to dodge his annoying old pal.

videos.title: #BabysitterWar
videos.overview: A client compliments one of the girls, but Sam and Cat aren't sure to whom he was referring, so they get competitive and try to outshine each other as babysitters.

videos.title: #GoomerSitting
videos.overview: Sam and Cat agree to babysit Goomer while Dice is away; Goomer loses his eyesight before a big match.

videos.title: #ToddlerClimbing
videos.overview: Sam and Cat confront a competing babysitting service when they post bad reviews about Sam and Cat's babysitting service.

videos.title: #MommaGoomer
videos.overview: Dice enlists the help of Sam and Cat to convince Goomer's mother that Goomer is a high school teacher.

videos.title: #BabysittingCommercial
videos.overview: Sam and Cat make a commercial for their business that features Dice's dog. A family claims that Dice's dog belongs to them.

videos.title: #RevengeOfTheBritBrats
videos.overview: Gwen and Ruby return and drive a wedge between Sam and Cat.

videos.title: #MotorcycleMystery
videos.overview: Sam, Dice, and Goomer go to a mixed-martial arts fight, leaving Cat at home to study. Sam's motorcycle goes missing. Cat loses her memory.

videos.title: #SecretSafe
videos.overview: Sam opens a safe in her bedroom and discovers a tunnel leading to a secret room. Cat films herself for 24 hours.

videos.title: #OscarTheOuch
videos.overview: Sam Puckett and Cat Valentine babysit a very accident-prone boy named Oscar. They then try their best to make Oscar have fun while keeping him safe. [

videos.title: #DollSitting
videos.overview: Sam and Cat are hired to baby-sit a doll on Halloween. Cat thinks she turned Dice into a monkey.

videos.title: #PeezyB
videos.overview: Sam gets a job as the assistant to the huge rap star Peezy B. Cat finds babysitting much more challenging without Sam around to help.

videos.title: #SalmonCat
videos.overview: An old TV show's title causes problems for the girls because it's similar to their business's name, so Sam and Cat try to find the show's creators, who are in the midst of a long-standing feud.

videos.title: #Twinfection
videos.overview: Cat pranks Sam by using a pair of twins they're watching, and Sam gets even by pranking Cat with Melanie, Sam's twin sister.

videos.title: #MyPoober
videos.overview: A tyke refuses to part with her old stuffed toy, but the gals try to persuade her to change her mind.

videos.title: #MadAboutShoe
videos.overview: Cat becomes obsessed with finding a missing shoe, even though she's supposed to be making special meatballs to replace all of the ones Sam ate.

videos.title: #MagicATM
videos.overview: Sam inquires about Cat's spending spree, so Cat takes her to an ATM that's giving out free cash, leading Sam to question the legality of the scenario.

videos.title: #Lumpatious
videos.overview: Sam and Cat try to get the word "lumpatious" into the dictionary after making a bet that it is a real word.

videos.title: #TheKillerTunaJump: #Freddie #Jade #Robbie
videos.overview: Sam and Jade become friends, which makes Cat jealous, so she makes friends with Freddie Benson. Then Sam, makes friends with Robbie and she has to jump over a tank full of vicious man-eating tunafish with her motorcycle.

videos.title: #YayDay
videos.overview: Cat creates a holiday in order to buy gifts for everyone, and then she peeks at the gifts and is displeased with her present from Sam.

videos.title: #BrainCrush
videos.overview: A popular new cell-phone game appears to be addictive to almost everyone, including Sam and Cat's pals and the audience at Cat's show.

videos.title: #BlueDogSoda
videos.overview: A popular soda pop is banned, so the girls make their own version of it and sell it, which gets them in trouble with the authorities.

videos.title: #BlooperEpisode
videos.overview: Fans comically approach the actors, who are on a lunch break and due back on the set soon.

videos.title: #FresnoGirl
videos.overview: Sam and Cat bribe a child to raise her grades in exchange for a doll, but the cost of the doll and its accessories are more than they expected. Meanwhile, Goomer can't find his lucky T-shirt.

videos.title: #StuckInABox
videos.overview: Cat gets trapped inside of Dice's magic trick, derailing her plans to go to a theme park with Sam.

videos.title: #SuperPsycho
videos.overview: Nora seeks vengeance and goes after Dice, prompting Sam and Cat to ask Nevel for help.

videos.title: #DroneBabyDrone
videos.overview: The girls use a drone service for deliveries, but it's not hassle-free.

videos.title: #FirstClassProblems
videos.overview: The girls must accompany two kids on an airplane after they survive the challenges of the airport.

videos.title: #KnockOut
videos.overview: When Sam and Cat try to help Goomer with a supposed bully at his gym, Sam ends up inadvertently knocking out an MMA champion and quickly gets pulled into the world of professional fighting.

videos.title: #WeStealARockStar
videos.overview: A rock star gets injured by the girls, who take a bad situation and make it worse as they try to hide what they did.

videos.title: #GettinWiggy
videos.overview: Dice gets a hair-modeling job in Arizona, so Cat accompanies him on the trip while Nona bunks with Sam for the weekend.

awards: Nominated for 1 Primetime Emmy. 4 wins & 7 nominations total
